a573e4f662.q: What is the Business Roundtable's expanded definition of corporate purpose according to recent research?
a573e4f662.a: The Business Roundtable, an association of CEOs, has significantly expanded their definition of the purpose of a corporation to now include much more than just shareholders. They now include all stakeholders, including customers, employees, suppliers, and communities.

b6246b64ae.q: What three questions should organizations ask about board of directors according to Magellan?
b6246b64ae.a: The three questions are: does your purpose differentiate your organization as a provider or employer of choice; can all your key stakeholders stand behind and actively support your purpose; and does your organization's purpose motivate employees and volunteers to be more productive, more resilient and stay with the organization longer.
